mapper.sql: sale_id, product_id, sku_id, sale_price, sale_stock, limit_per_user, start_at, end_at, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flash_sale ( sale_id, product_id, sku_id, sale_price, sale_stock, limit_per_user, start_at, end_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{saleId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{salePrice}, #{saleStock}, #{limitPerUser}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flash_sale WHERE sale_id = #{saleId} AND is_deleted = 0
